title: Improving Bayesian Network Learning in Project Risk Management through Deep Generative Models
summary: Data and code accompanying a research paper on improving Bayesian Network learning for project risk management on small datasets using Deep Generative Models. The Python scripts fit SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer on benchmark and project-risk datasets, then use SDV's evaluate_quality/SingleTableMetadata to score the synthetic samples against the originals.
